_about: Round 32 (Robert: 'companions and pets grown up'). Companions fight in a STYLE you choose, carry GEAR you give them, level with what they do, and can be knocked down (they're back after a while, or when you rest). Familiars EVOLVE through stages as the bond deepens; the TAMING skill (fed animals, finds, bites) opens a tree of perks, one choice per tier. Your HOME grows from Elder Mo's plot into a COMPOUND, stage by stage, and a compound looks after your companion and familiar while you're away.

striker.name: Striker
striker.desc: Goes after whatever's nearest and hits hardest.

tricks.name: Opening Blow
tricks.desc: You hit a little harder while they fight beside you.

tricks.name: Finishing Habit
tricks.desc: Foes they bring low drop you a little life.

tricks.name: Killing Rhythm
tricks.desc: Your strikes find weak spots more often.

guard.name: Guard
guard.desc: Keeps your shoulder. Steps into blows meant for you, half the time.

tricks.name: Hold the Line
tricks.desc: Blows land softer while they stand with you.

tricks.name: Shoulder Check
tricks.desc: A steadier stance: a little ward.

tricks.name: Unbroken
tricks.desc: Hard to hurt, harder to knock down.

scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Fights only what comes close. Turns things up as you walk, and spots what's hidden.

tricks.name: Eyes Ahead
tricks.desc: You see further.

tricks.name: Pathfinder
tricks.desc: Gathering turns up more.

tricks.name: Hidden Ways
tricks.desc: You notice more of what is hidden.

healer.name: Mender
healer.desc: Stays back and tends you. Hits softly, but you mend as you walk and after every kill.

tricks.name: Clean Bandage
tricks.desc: You mend faster on your feet.

tricks.name: Second Wind
tricks.desc: Blows land softer.

tricks.name: Triage
tricks.desc: Every kill gives back much more life.

attendant.name: Attendant
attendant.desc: Keeps your sitting quiet and your thoughts clear. Barely fights; qi and insight come easier.

tricks.name: Steady Breath
tricks.desc: Sitting is deeper.

tricks.name: Quiet Margin
tricks.desc: Insight comes easier.

tricks.name: Shared Stillness
tricks.desc: A fuller sea of qi from everything you do.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.desc: Hunts ahead of you and reads the ground: better loot, more gathered, a wide sense of what is near.

tricks.name: Cut Sign
tricks.desc: You sense much further.

tricks.name: Lucky Trail
tricks.desc: Better finds from every foe.

tricks.name: Quarry Eye
tricks.desc: A hunter's aim: you strike truer.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: Plants a shield in front of you. Takes the blow for you most of the time; hits little.

tricks.name: Iron Stance
tricks.desc: More ward.

tricks.name: Turn the Blade
tricks.desc: You slip some blows entirely.

tricks.name: Last Wall
tricks.desc: Blows land far softer.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.desc: Quick, precise, always one step ahead of the foe. Strikes fast and teaches you the timing of a blow.

tricks.name: Riposte Eye
tricks.desc: A wider moment to parry.

tricks.name: Light Feet
tricks.desc: You move quicker.

tricks.name: Perfect Line
tricks.desc: Telling blows land often.

stages.title: grown
stages.told: %s has grown. The bones are heavier, the eyes steadier; it stands between you and things now, and bites.

stages.title: fierce
stages.told: %s is fierce now -- a beast the deep would be proud of. Its gifts to you have grown with it.

stages.title: spirit beast
stages.told: %s is a spirit beast. Something of the deep's light lives in it; what it gives you, it gives twice over.

tricks.name: Sniff Out
tricks.desc: It points you toward what is hidden near you.

tricks.name: Guard Stance
tricks.desc: It stands between you and the dark; blows land a little softer.

tricks.name: Pounce
tricks.desc: It hits foes as you do: a keener edge.

tricks.name: Lick Wounds
tricks.desc: You mend as you walk with it.

tricks.name: Spirit Sense
tricks.desc: The deep's light in it sharpens your own sight and luck.

tricks.name: One Pack
tricks.desc: Fully bonded: it fights, feels and finds as part of you.

a.name: Keen Nose
a.desc: Your familiar turns things up half again as often.

b.name: Sharp Fangs
b.desc: Its bites hurt half again as much.

a.name: Thick Hide
a.desc: What it gives you grows by a third more.

b.name: Quick Paws
b.desc: It finds faster, and senses further (+3).

a.name: Pack Bond
a.desc: When it bites, you mend a little (2% of your life).

b.name: Wild Call
b.desc: Animals come to trust you in half the feedings; the bond grows half again as fast.

a.name: Scent Trail
a.desc: Better loot while it travels with you.

b.name: Guarded Flank
b.desc: Blows land softer; you also slip a few.

a.name: Hunter's Rush
a.desc: You hit harder and more precisely beside it.

b.name: Gentle Paws
b.desc: Steady mending as you walk, and more life from kills.

a.name: Wild Instinct
a.desc: You sense and gather much more.

b.name: Spirit Bond
b.desc: Qi and insight flow easier while it is near.

a.name: Alpha's Call
a.desc: Its whole pack's strength joins yours.

b.name: Deep Kinship
b.desc: You move quicker and the bond grows faster.

stages.name: Elder Mo's plot
stages.desc: A tent, a garden, a bench, a chest and a bed.

stages.name: a cottage
stages.desc: Walls and a roof instead of a tent. A night here mends more than your body: the well-rested hour is twice as long, and the chest holds twice the stacks.

stages.name: a courtyard
stages.desc: A fenced yard with lanterns and a cultivation stone of your own: sit and cultivate at home at the shrine's rate. The bench works a second order at once.

stages.name: a compound
stages.desc: Quarters for your companion and a kennel for your familiar. While you're away, your companion trains (experience by the hour) and your familiar's bond deepens. A wall around it all.
